items.title: PHP Critical Vulnerability and Attack Timeline
points: Two critical bugs in PHP (the server-side language running ~70% of websites whose primary language is known) enable unauthenticated remote server takeover.
Attackers began exploiting the vulnerabilities before patches shipped Wednesday; Cloudflare reported attacks hours before the fix landed.
Finland, Netherlands, and France preemptively took government websites offline as a precaution.
About 884,000 servers still run PHP 8.1 or older, meaning patches will roll out slowly across the internet.

items.title: Cryptocurrency-Specific Risks from PHP Exploits
points: Attackers can use compromised websites to serve fake pages that drain cryptocurrency wallets connected to those sites.
This mirrors previous DNS hijack (redirecting domain names to attacker-controlled servers) attacks against DeFi platforms Compound, Celer, and Curve.
Users have virtually no way to protect themselves; responsibility rests entirely on website owners and hosting providers to apply patches.

items.title: Solana's Alpenglow Upgrade Launches
points: New consensus protocol (the mechanism by which blockchain nodes agree on valid transactions) retired TowerBFT, Solana's consensus engine since its 2020 launch.
Transaction finality improved from approximately 12.8 seconds to roughly 150 milliseconds, a major speed increase.
Despite being called the 'most ambitious' upgrade since Ethereum's Merge, SOL price remained near $108, unchanged from late August levels.

items.title: Regulatory and Banking Friction
points: UK banks fielded 10,000 complaints over blocked crypto transfers within 90 days, per a Stand With Crypto report.
Lloyds received the most complaints despite publishing no formal policy restricting cryptocurrency transfers.
OCC finalized GENIUS Act stablecoin rules setting reserve, redemption, and risk standards for issuers, though the application timeline remains unclear.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Movement and Market Sentiment
points: BTC traded near $85,000, driven by technology sector strength across broader equity markets.
Bullish commentary from prominent figures like Michael Saylor, who declared the next Bitcoin bull run has begun, indicates elevated confidence in near-term price direction.
Price action accompanied by institutional interest signals growing mainstream acceptance of cryptocurrency as an asset class.

items.title: Standard Chartered's Crypto Custody Move
points: Standard Chartered, a major international bank, acquired a crypto custody solution (custody refers to secure storage and management of digital assets) to bring the capability in-house.
Move represents a shift toward traditional financial institutions building native crypto infrastructure rather than relying on external providers.
Signals confidence among major financial institutions that the regulatory environment and market adoption justify direct participation in digital asset services.
